plan.name: Use Stove Burner to Heat Mug
plan.strategy: Locate a mug, heat it on a stove burner, and place it in the coffeemachine.
steps: Find a mug in one of the cabinets, drawers, or on the countertops.
Take the mug to a stove burner.
Place the mug on the stove burner and turn it on to heat the mug.
Wait until the mug is sufficiently heated.
Remove the heated mug from the stove burner.
Place the heated mug into the coffeemachine.
